name: The Darkin Blade / The Darkin Blade 2 / The Darkin Blade 3

values.binNote: Wiki's sweetspot multiplier is 1.75 (sd), but the bin's QSweetSpotBonus=0.75 and QEdgeDamage formula reads 'QDamage * 1 + QSweetSpotBonus' i.e. QDamage*(1+0.75)=QDamage*1.75 - same net multiplier, values stated here match QEdgeDamage's evaluated 1.75x, not the raw 0.75 bonus field.
No calculation row directly produces the second-cast multiplier; wiki's (1+cd) factor is applied on top of AatroxQ#QDamage using QRampBonus=0.25, matching the wiki's cd=0.25 var.
No single calculation row exists for this compound (ramp x sweetspot) tooltip value; derived from QDamage x (1+QRampBonus) x 1.75 (the QEdgeDamage multiplier).
No calculation row directly produces the third-cast multiplier; wiki's (1+cd*2) factor applied using QRampBonus=0.25.
No single calculation row exists for this compound (ramp x sweetspot) tooltip value; derived from QDamage x (1+QRampBonus*2) x 1.75 (the QEdgeDamage multiplier).

values.meaning: Recast window before the ability goes on cooldown
values.quote: If '''Aatrox''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.

values.meaning: Static cooldown between the three casts
values.quote: with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts
values.binNote: No explicit data row for the 1-second inter-cast delay was found in the Q slot; likely a hardcoded animation/cast gate rather than a named DataValue.

mechanics.claim: The Q's cooldown begins on the first cast and is reset/restarted by each successive recast, rather than starting only once all casts are used or on the last cast.
mechanics.quote: Cooldown starts on first cast and restarts on each successive recast

mechanics.claim: Failing to recast within 4 seconds of the previous cast puts the whole ability on cooldown, ending the combo early.
mechanics.quote: If '''Aatrox''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.

mechanics.claim: Damage is computed from Aatrox's current stats at the moment the strike lands, not locked in at cast time, so buffs/debuffs gained mid-cast still apply.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.

mechanics.claim: All of the Q's own damage modifiers (per-cast ramp, sweetspot bonus) combine multiplicatively rather than additively.
There is a short window after each cast during which Aatrox cannot issue a basic attack, delaying his next auto in a damage-race scenario.
mechanics.quote: There's a small period of time in which Aatrox can't declare basic attacks after casting ''The Darkin Blade''.

mechanics.claim: Each of the three casts counts as a separate ability activation, triggering on-cast effects (e.g. Spellblade) independently per cast.
mechanics.quote: Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
